tEn: Understanding Positional Embeddings in Modern LLMs
tZh: 理解现代大语言模型中的位置嵌入
sEn: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of positional embedding methods in LLMs, from learned absolute embeddings and fixed sinusoidal encodings to rotary position embeddings (RoPE), and surveys their use in recent open-weight models.
sZh: 本文系统梳理了大语言模型中的位置嵌入方法，涵盖可学习的绝对位置嵌入、固定正弦编码以及旋转位置嵌入（RoPE），并综述了近期开放权重模型中的采用情况。
absEn: This article provides a comprehensive walkthrough of how large language models encode and process token position information, covering both classic and contemporary methods. It begins by explaining why explicit positional information is needed, using examples where word order changes sentence meaning, and notes that causal attention masks supply only implicit order cues. The article then examines learned absolute positional embeddings as used in GPT-2, including a PyTorch implementation, and discusses their limitations for extending context windows. It also covers the fixed sine and cosine positional encodings from the original transformer, which become relevant for understanding rotary position embeddings (RoPE). The article concludes by surveying which positional embedding choices are used in recent open-weight models, showing how modern architectures adapt or omit explicit positional encodings. Readers gain both a conceptual and practical understanding of positional embedding mechanisms and their trade-offs in modern LLM design.
absZh: 本文全面介绍了大语言模型如何编码和处理词元位置信息，涵盖经典方法与现代方法。文章首先解释了为何需要显式的位置信息，并以词序改变句子含义的例子加以说明，同时指出因果注意力掩码只能提供隐式的顺序线索。随后，文章考察了 GPT-2 中使用的可学习绝对位置嵌入，包括一个 PyTorch 实现，并讨论了其在扩展上下文窗口方面的局限。文章还介绍了原始 Transformer 中固定的正弦和余弦位置编码，这对于理解旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）具有重要意义。最后，文章综述了近期开放权重模型采用了哪些位置嵌入方案，展示了现代架构如何调整或省略显式位置编码。读者将能从概念和实践两个层面理解位置嵌入机制及其在现代大语言模型设计中的权衡。

full.sec: 1. Where position information enters an LLM
full.secZh: 1. 位置信息在 LLM 中的输入位置

items.en: Let's start with the overall architecture. A tokenizer encodes the input text into token IDs. Next, the input token embedding layer of an LLM maps each of these IDs to a vector of numbers. We usually refer to these entries in that vector as "features" (similar to classic ML). The transformer blocks inside the LLM then modify these vectors using attention and feedforward layers. Lastly, the model's output layer produces logit scores (converted into probabilities) for the next token.
items.zh: 让我们从整体架构开始。分词器将输入文本编码为词元 ID。接着，LLM 的输入词元嵌入层将这些 ID 中的每一个映射为一个数值向量。我们通常将该向量中的这些条目称为“特征”（类似于经典机器学习）。然后，LLM 内部的 Transformer 块使用注意力机制和前馈层来修改这些向量。最后，模型的输出层为下一个词元生成 logit 分数（转换为概率）。

items.en: The following shows this path in GPT-2 (a relatively classic LLM) and MiniMax-M3 (a more recent LLM released this year; a placeholder for most other recent LLMs). As we can see, the architectures are not too different from each other, but before we get to the positional information parts, let's focus on the orange blocks for now (the token embedding layers) and the transformer blocks above them; the other architecture differences aren't needed for this explanation.
items.zh: 下图展示了 GPT-2（一个相对经典的 LLM）和 MiniMax-M3（今年发布的一个较新的 LLM；作为大多数其他近期 LLM 的占位符）中的这一路径。正如我们所见，架构之间并没有太大不同，但在我们讨论位置信息部分之前，现在让我们先关注橙色块（词元嵌入层）及其上方的 Transformer 块；其他架构差异对于本解释并不需要。

items.capEn: Figure 2: Token embedding layers in GPT-2 and MiniMax-M3, highlighted in orange. (Side note: M3’s first three out of 60 feedforward layers are dense not MoEs.)
items.capZh: 图 2：GPT-2 和 MiniMax-M3 中的词元嵌入层，以橙色高亮。（旁注：M3 的 60 个前馈层中前三个是稠密层而非 MoE。）

items.en: A token embedding layer, shown in the figure above, maps each token ID to a vector. Position information is then added afterward. Concretely, and as we will discuss in more detail later, GPT-2 adds a position vector to each token embedding before the modified embedding enters the first transformer block. On the other hand, MiniMax-M3 adds the positional information in each transformer block using a method called RoPE inside attention.
items.zh: 如上图所示，词元嵌入层将每个词元 ID 映射为一个向量。然后，位置信息被添加在后面。具体来说，正如我们稍后将更详细讨论的，GPT-2 在修改后的嵌入进入第一个 Transformer 块之前，向每个词元嵌入添加一个位置向量。另一方面，MiniMax-M3 在注意力机制内部使用一种称为 RoPE 的方法，在每个 Transformer 块中添加位置信息。

items.en: We will talk about these methods in more detail later, but first, let's start with the big picture information explaining why explicit positional information is added or needed.
items.zh: 我们稍后将更详细地讨论这些方法，但首先，让我们从宏观信息开始，解释为什么需要添加或需要显式的位置信息。

full.secZh: 1.1 为什么要加入位置信息？

items.en: Consider the following two input sentences as a simple example:

items.en: 1. "The red fox jumps over the gray fox."

items.en: 2. "The gray fox jumps over the red fox."
items.zh: 2. “The gray fox jumps over the red fox.”（灰狐狸跳过红狐狸。）

items.en: Changing the word order changes which fox does the jumping, as illustrated in the following figure.

items.en: For the examples in this article, we will treat each word as one token for simplicity. (As you know, real tokenizers can split words into smaller subword tokens.) The first sentence then has eight token positions, from 0 through 7.

items.en: Note that “fox”, which appears twice in the input sentence, gets the same token ID 2 in both cases. And since they both have the same token ID, irrespective of the position in the input sentence, they would get the same embedding vector from the embedding layer. (For those who are interested in more details on how this selection from the embedding table looks like, check Appendix A.)
items.zh: 注意，输入句子中出现两次的“fox”在两种情况下都获得相同的词元 ID 2。由于它们具有相同的词元 ID，无论它们在输入句子中的位置如何，它们都会从嵌入层获得相同的嵌入向量。（对于那些对嵌入表的选择细节感兴趣的读者，请参阅附录 A。）

items.en: Now, let’s consider a regular self-attention mechanism with no positional encoding (and no causal mask), where every input token can attend to every other token in the input. In this scenario, swapping any two words, like “red” and “gray”, would still result in the same embeddings and attention scores between each token pair.
items.zh: 现在，让我们考虑一个没有位置编码（也没有因果掩码）的常规自注意力机制，其中每个输入词元都可以关注输入中的任何其他词元。在这种情况下，交换任意两个单词（如“red”和“gray”）仍然会导致每个词元对之间具有相同的嵌入和注意力分数。

items.en: GPT-style models do use a causal (autoregressive) mask, which restricts each token to itself and earlier tokens. Interestingly, this causal mask gives the computation some implicit order information. In our example, “jumps” can attend to “red” in the first sentence and “gray” in the second. So, a causal LLM can theoretically already distinguish these sentences even without explicit positional embeddings. (We will return to this idea later when discussing the “NoPE” concept.)
items.zh: GPT 风格的模型确实使用了因果（自回归）掩码，这将每个词元限制为只能关注自身及之前的词元。有趣的是，这种因果掩码为计算提供了一些隐式的顺序信息。在我们的例子中，“jumps”在第一个句子中可以关注“red”，在第二个句子中可以关注“gray”。因此，因果 LLM 理论上即使没有显式的位置嵌入也能区分这些句子。（我们将在讨论“NoPE”概念时回到这个想法。）

items.en: Nonetheless, GPT-2 and most newer LLMs include explicit positional information because it gives attention a direct signal about positions. That’s because even though the causal mask determines which tokens are accessible and provides implicit order information, it doesn’t distinguish a separation of one position from a separation of ten, for example. So, explicit positional methods are still useful (or even essential), since they supply that information.
items.zh: 尽管如此，GPT-2 和大多数较新的 LLM 都包含显式的位置信息，因为它为注意力机制提供了关于位置的直接信号。这是因为，尽管因果掩码决定了哪些词元可被访问并提供了隐式的顺序信息，但它无法区分一个位置的间隔和十个位置的间隔。因此，显式的位置方法仍然有用（甚至必不可少），因为它们提供了这种信息。

full.sec: 2. Adding a position vector to each token embedding
full.secZh: 2. 为每个词元嵌入添加位置向量

paras.en: We briefly talked about _implicit_ positional information through causal attention masks (and we will revisit this again in more detail later). However, we now switch gears and talk about the _explicit_ ways to add positional information.
paras.zh: 我们简要讨论了通过因果注意力掩码所体现的_隐式_位置信息（稍后我们将更详细地再次讨论这一点）。不过，现在我们转换话题，讨论添加位置信息的_显式_方法。

paras.en: The perhaps simplest and most direct (but not "cheapest") approach is to give each sequence position its own vector. We add that vector to the token embedding, so the resulting, modified embedding vector is then passed to the first transformer block. This exact procedure is discussed in the following subsections.
paras.zh: 也许最简单、最直接（但并非“最廉价”）的方法是为每个序列位置分配一个专属向量。我们将该向量加到词元嵌入上，于是得到的、经过修改的嵌入向量随后被送入第一个 Transformer 块。这一具体过程将在后续小节中讨论。

full.sec: 2.1 Learned absolute position embeddings in GPT-2
full.secZh: 2.1 GPT-2 中学习到的绝对位置嵌入

items.en: To illustrate the use of an explicit, learned positional vector to the input embeddings, let's consider GPT-2 as a concrete example. GPT-2 learns a table of position vectors during training. The following figure illustrates where these vectors are used in the architecture, that is, immediately after the token embedding lookup and before the first transformer block.
items.zh: 为了说明在输入嵌入中使用显式的、学习到的位置向量，我们以 GPT-2 作为一个具体例子。GPT-2 在训练过程中学习一个位置向量表。下图展示了这些向量在架构中的使用位置，即紧接在 token 嵌入查找之后、第一个 Transformer 块之前。

items.capEn: Figure 5: GPT-2 adds absolute position information before the transformer blocks, as highlighted in purple. The dimensions shown are for GPT-2 XL.
items.capZh: 图 5：GPT-2 在 Transformer 块之前加入绝对位置信息，以紫色高亮。所示维度为 GPT-2 XL 的维度。

items.en: The positional embedding layer depicted in the figure above follows the same implementation as the token embedding layer, i.e., they have exactly the same output dimensions so that the resulting input vectors can be added to each other. The code below shows that with an excerpt of a GPT-2 code implementation:
items.zh: 上图中描绘的位置嵌入层遵循与 token 嵌入层相同的实现，即它们具有完全相同的输出维度，以便得到的输入向量可以相互相加。下面的代码通过 GPT-2 代码实现的一个片段展示了这一点：

items.en:
```
class GPTModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, cfg):
        super().__init__()
        self.tok_emb = nn.Embedding(cfg["vocab_size"], cfg["emb_dim"])
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(cfg["context_length"], cfg["emb_dim"])
        self.drop_emb = nn.Dropout(cfg["drop_rate"])

        self.trf_blocks = nn.Sequential(
            *[TransformerBlock(cfg) for _ in range(cfg["n_layers"])])

        self.final_norm = LayerNorm(cfg["emb_dim"])
        self.out_head = nn.Linear(
            cfg["emb_dim"], cfg["vocab_size"], bias=False
        )

    def forward(self, in_idx):
        batch_size, seq_len = in_idx.shape
        tok_embeds = self.tok_emb(in_idx)
        pos_embeds = self.pos_emb(torch.arange(seq_len, device=in_idx.device))
        x = tok_embeds + pos_embeds  # Shape [batch_size, num_tokens, emb_size]
        x = self.drop_emb(x)
        x = self.trf_blocks(x)
        x = self.final_norm(x)
        logits = self.out_head(x)
        return logits
```

items.en: *   and \(h_m\) is the resulting summed embedding and position vector.
items.zh: *   而 \(h_m\) 是求和得到的嵌入和位置向量。

items.en: The two vectors have the same width, so we add their entries element-wise. Figure 6 below shows this visually with a small numerical example.
items.zh: 这两个向量具有相同的宽度，因此我们逐元素相加。下面的图 6 用一个小的数值示例直观地展示了这一点。

items.capEn: Figure 6: Token and position embeddings are added element-wise. (I am following the convention here that neural network diagrams are usually read from bottom to top.)
items.capZh: 图 6：词元嵌入和位置嵌入逐元素相加。（此处遵循神经网络图通常从下往上阅读的惯例。）

items.en: In the figure above, at position 0, adding the token embedding [1, 1, 1] to the position embedding [1.1, 1.2, 1.3] gives [2.1, 2.2, 2.3]. By the way, the values in the figure are chosen to keep the illustration simple; in a real example, both embedding layers (tables) are initialized with small random values and learned during training.
items.zh: 在上图中，在位置 0 处，将词元嵌入[1, 1, 1]与位置嵌入[1.1, 1.2, 1.3]相加得到[2.1, 2.2, 2.3]。顺便说一下，图中的数值是为了简化说明而选择的；在真实示例中，两个嵌入层（表）都用小的随机值初始化，并在训练过程中学习。

items.en: So, what we covered in this section is a so-called _absolute_ positional method because the positional embedding _P m_ depends on the token’s own position _m_. In the previous example sentence, the two “fox” tokens have initially the same token embeddings, but because we are adding different positional vectors _P 2_ and _P 7_, they have different values before they enter the first transformer block. And consequently, the query, key, and value vectors inside the attention mechanisms then also receive representations that already include position information.
items.zh: 因此，我们在本节中介绍的是所谓的_绝对_位置方法，因为位置嵌入_P m_取决于词元自身的位置_m_。在前面的示例句子中，两个“fox”词元最初具有相同的词元嵌入，但由于我们添加了不同的位置向量_P 2_和_P 7_，它们在进入第一个 Transformer 块之前具有不同的值。因此，注意力机制内部的查询、键和值向量随后也接收到已经包含位置信息的表示。

items.en: Note that the original GPT-2 implementation has 1,024 learned position vectors. This means it only works with inputs with 1024 or fewer tokens. If we want to extend the context window, we would have to extend this embedding table. And since the embedding table (layer) is updated like any other layer during training, the context length would have to be decided before the training starts.
items.zh: 注意，原始的 GPT-2 实现有 1,024 个学习的位置向量。这意味着它只能处理 1024 个或更少词元的输入。如果我们想扩展上下文窗口，就必须扩展这个嵌入表。而且由于嵌入表（层）在训练过程中像其他层一样被更新，上下文长度必须在训练开始前决定。

items.en: Extending the context would be very expensive since the table can become very large. For example, in the case of GPT-2 Medium, the positional embedding layer weights only make up 0.30% of the total weights at 1,024 positions. However, if we increased the context length to a nowadays common 100k range, they would make up >22% of the total model weights, which would be very uneconomic.
items.zh: 扩展上下文将非常昂贵，因为表可能变得非常大。例如，在 GPT-2 Medium 的情况下，在 1,024 个位置时，位置嵌入层的权重仅占总权重的 0.30%。然而，如果我们将上下文长度增加到如今常见的 100k 范围，它们将占模型总权重的>22%，这将非常不经济。

full.sec: 2.2 Fixed sinusoidal position encodings in the original transformer
full.secZh: 2.2 原始 Transformer 中的固定正弦位置编码

items.en: The original “Attention Is All You Need” transformer from 2017, which predates GPT, uses the same addition mechanism, but computes its position vectors with fixed sine and cosine functions. Figure 7 below shows this addition before both the encoder and decoder stacks. The encoder processes the input sequence, and the decoder generates the output sequence. (The reason why it’s introduced here is that the sine and cosine functions will become relevant again later when discussing RoPE.)
items.zh: 2017 年提出的原始“Attention Is All You Need”Transformer（早于 GPT）采用了相同的加法机制，但使用固定的正弦和余弦函数计算位置向量。下图 7 展示了在编码器和解码器堆叠之前进行的这种加法。编码器处理输入序列，解码器生成输出序列。（这里介绍它的原因是，正弦和余弦函数在后续讨论 RoPE 时会再次变得相关。）

items.capEn: Figure 7: Sinusoidal position encodings added to the token embeddings as highlighted in purple.
items.capZh: 图 7：加到词元嵌入上的正弦位置编码，以紫色高亮。

items.en: The original transformer also scales its token embeddings by \(\sqrt{d_{\text{model}}}\) before adding the position vectors, where \(d_{\text{model}}\) is the embedding width.
items.zh: 原始 Transformer 在添加位置向量之前，还会将词元嵌入乘以 \(\sqrt{d_{\text{model}}}\) 进行缩放，其中 \(d_{\text{model}}\) 是嵌入维度。

items.capEn: the formula used in the original transformer (depicted in Figure 7) is:
items.capZh: 原始 Transformer 中使用的公式（如图 7 所示）为：

items.capEn: This scaling by √(_d_ model) is a minor technical detail, but for those who are curious, the motivation behind this scaling factor is not explained in the transformer paper, but as I discussed with colleagues on a Twitter thread many years ago, it’s likely to put the token embeddings and sinusoidal positional encodings on comparable numerical magnitudes at initialization, so the position vectors don’t dominate the sum when we add them.
items.capZh: 这个按√（_d_ model）进行的缩放是一个次要的技术细节，但对于好奇的人来说，transformer 论文中并未解释这个缩放因子背后的动机，但正如我多年前在 Twitter 线程上与同事讨论的那样，它很可能是为了在初始化时让 token 嵌入和正弦位置编码处于可比较的数值量级，这样当我们把它们相加时，位置向量就不会在求和中占主导地位。

items.en: In the GPT-2 case, this scaling wasn’t necessary because the original GPT-2 code initialized the token embeddings to have an initial standard deviation of 0.02 and the position embeddings to have an initial standard deviation of 0.01 so that they were already roughly on the same scale.
items.zh: 在 GPT-2 的情况下，这种缩放并非必要，因为原始 GPT-2 代码将词元嵌入初始化为标准差 0.02，将位置嵌入初始化为标准差 0.01，因此它们已经大致处于相同的尺度。

items.en: Now, the more interesting point is how the position embeddings \(P_m\) are computed.
items.zh: 现在，更有趣的一点是位置嵌入 \(P_m\) 是如何计算的。

items.en: Concretely, each position vector has the following entries:
items.zh: 具体来说，每个位置向量具有以下条目：

items.capEn: As before, _m_ denotes the position. The index _i_ indexes a pair of features within the vector.
items.capZh: 和之前一样，_m_ 表示位置。索引 _i_ 索引向量内的一对特征。

items.en: Here, a feature is one number in the position vector. For example, let's assume we have a small vector with 8 values (\(d_{\text{model}} = 8)\) that has entries numbered 0 through 7. (In the original paper this was 512 for the small model and 1024 for the bigger model, instead of 8, but that would be hard to visualize.) We group these into four pairs so that \i\ goes from 0 through 3.
items.zh: 这里，一个特征就是位置向量中的一个数字。例如，假设我们有一个包含 8 个值的小向量（\(d_{\text{model}} = 8)\），其条目编号为 0 到 7。（在原始论文中，小模型使用 512，大模型使用 1024，而不是 8，但那样难以可视化。）我们将这些条目分成四对，因此 \i\ 从 0 到 3。

items.capEn: Figure 8: Sine and cosine entries for each feature pair.
items.capZh: 图 8：每个特征对的 sine 和 cosine 条目。

items.en: Here, the indices \2i\ and \2i+1\ select the two entries corresponding to pair \i\.
items.zh: 这里，索引 \2i\ 和 \2i+1\ 选择对应于对 \i\ 的两个条目。

items.en: As shown in the equation earlier, the angle at position \m\, which is then fed into the sine or cosine functions to obtain \P_{m,2i}\ or \P_{m,2i+1}\, respectively, is computed as follows:
items.zh: 如前一个公式所示，位置 \m\ 处的角度（然后分别输入正弦或余弦函数以获得 \P_{m,2i}\ 或 \P_{m,2i+1}\）计算如下：

items.capEn: Figure 9: The angle inside sine and cosine is the token position multiplied by the pair’s angular frequency.
items.capZh: 图 9：sine 和 cosine 内的角度是 token 位置乘以该对的角频率。

items.en: Figure 10 shows this calculation for all four pairs of our 8-feature example at position \m = 2\.
items.zh: 图 10 展示了在位置 \m = 2\ 时，我们的 8 特征示例中所有四对的计算。

items.capEn: Figure 10: The four sine and cosine pairs at position 2.
items.capZh: 图 10：位置 2 处的四个 sine 和 cosine 对。

items.en: For an eight-feature embedding, the four frequencies are 1, 0.1, 0.01, and 0.001 radians per position. At position 2, the first pair in row 1 is \(\sin 2, \cos 2\) ≈ \((0.909, -0.416)\).
items.zh: 对于一个八维特征的嵌入，四个频率分别为每位置 1、0.1、0.01 和 0.001 弧度。在位置 2 处，第 1 行中的第一对为 \(\sin 2, \cos 2\) ≈ \((0.909, -0.416)\)。

items.en: The second pair, in row 2, changes more slowly, giving \(\sin 0.2, \cos 0.2\) ≈ \((0.199, 0.980)\).
The figure below visualizes the sine and cosine calculations for different pairs, which are then collected in a position vector.
items.zh: 下图可视化了不同对的 sine 和 cosine 计算，随后这些结果被收集到一个位置向量中。

items.capEn: Figure 11: Sampling sine and cosine functions to form a position vector.
items.capZh: 图 11：采样 sine 和 cosine 函数以形成位置向量。

items.en: In short, this method is a (more complicated) alternative to obtaining positional embedding vectors compared to the GPT-2 method discussed earlier.
items.zh: 简而言之，与前面讨论的 GPT-2 方法相比，该方法是一种（更复杂的）获取位置嵌入向量的替代方案。

items.en: Similar to the GPT-2 embeddings, these are also absolute embeddings because each vector is computed from its own position. However, in contrast to the GPT-2 approach, the sine and cosine functions stay fixed during training. (Also, they can be extended and evaluated beyond the training positions, like beyond the context length of 1024, although that alone doesn't guarantee that the model will perform well there, because it hasn't seen those during training.)
items.zh: 与 GPT-2 嵌入类似，这些也是绝对嵌入，因为每个向量都是根据其自身位置计算得到的。然而，与 GPT-2 方法不同，sine 和 cosine 函数在训练期间保持固定。（此外，它们可以扩展到训练位置之外进行评估，例如超出 1024 的上下文窗口，但仅此并不能保证模型在该处表现良好，因为模型在训练期间并未见过这些位置。）

items.en: To summarize, Figure 12 below compares the two ways of obtaining a position vector we discussed so far.
items.zh: 总结来说，下图 12 比较了我们目前讨论的两种获取位置向量的方式。

items.capEn: Figure 12: Fixed sinusoidal and learned absolute positional embeddings.
items.capZh: 图 12：固定正弦和可学习的绝对位置嵌入。

items.en: (The optional Appendix C.1 covers more detail on how these two methods compare in practice in small empirical experiments.)
items.zh: （可选的附录 C.1 更详细地介绍了这两种方法在小规模实证实验中的实际比较。）

items.en: This sinusoidal method may look like an overly complicated way to obtain positional embeddings; however, understanding it will be useful when talking about RoPE in the next section.
items.zh: 这种正弦方法看起来可能是一种过于复杂的位置嵌入获取方式；然而，理解它对于下一节讨论 RoPE 会很有帮助。

items.en: Also, there is some rationale behind it. The authors chose sine and cosine because shifting by a certain offset yields a certain deterministic difference. For example, the difference between positions 2 and 5 and the difference between positions 102 and 105 are both 3, which then results in the same rotation.
items.zh: 此外，它背后是有一定道理的。作者选择正弦和余弦，是因为按某个偏移量平移会产生某种确定性的差异。例如，位置 2 到 5 的差值与位置 102 到 105 的差值都是 3，因此会产生相同的旋转。

items.en: According to the *Attention Is All You Need* paper:
items.zh: 根据《Attention Is All You Need》论文：

items.en: "...easily learn to attend by relative positions, since for any fixed offset \(_k_\), \(_PE_{pos + k}\) can be represented as a linear function of \(_PE_{pos}\)."
items.zh: “……可以很容易地学会按相对位置进行注意力计算，因为对于任意固定偏移 \(_k_\)，\(_PE_{pos + k}\) 都可以表示为 \(_PE_{pos}\) 的线性函数。”

items.en: Or in less technical terms, the authors hypothesized that this property would make it easier for attention to learn relationships such as "three tokens earlier."
items.zh: 或者用不那么技术化的说法，作者假设这一性质会让注意力机制更容易学习诸如“早三个词元”这样的关系。

items.en: Figure 13 below illustrates this for one sine/cosine pair. A rotation is a linear transformation, and both three-position shifts use the same rotation.
items.zh: 下面的图 13 以一对正弦/余弦为例说明了这一点。旋转是一种线性变换，而两个三位置偏移使用的是同一个旋转。

items.capEn: Figure 13: For a pair with angular frequency 0.1 radians per position, a shift of three positions always rotates the pair by 0.3 radians.
items.capZh: 图 13：对于角频率为每位置 0.1 弧度的一对，三个位置的偏移总是将该对旋转 0.3 弧度。

full.secZh: 3. 使用 RoPE 编码相对位置

paras.en: So, the sinusoidal method above is still considered an absolute positional encoding because the vector added to each token embedding represents that token's position counted from the start of the sequence.
paras.zh: 因此，上述正弦方法仍被视为绝对位置编码，因为添加到每个词元嵌入的向量表示该词元从序列起始处开始计数的位置。

paras.en: As shown in the previous figure, for example, tokens at positions 2 and 5 receive the position vectors \(P_2\) and \(P_5\). If we move those tokens to positions 102 and 105, they're still three positions apart. But each token gets a different position vector because its absolute position \(m\) has changed.
paras.zh: 例如，如前一图所示，位置 2 和 5 的词元分别接收位置向量 \(P_2\) 和 \(P_5\)。如果我们将这些词元移动到位置 102 和 105，它们仍然相隔三个位置。但每个词元会得到不同的位置向量，因为其绝对位置 \(m\) 已经改变。

paras.en: So their attention score can change even when the token embeddings stay the same. The sinusoidal structure still gives the model a way to learn relative relationships.
paras.zh: 因此，即使词元嵌入保持不变，它们的注意力分数也可能改变。正弦结构仍然为模型提供了一种学习相对关系的方式。

paras.en: Anyways, RoPE, which we will discuss below, builds this relative relationship directly into the attention calculation. RoPE, which Su et al. introduced in the 2021 RoFormer paper, stands for Rotary Position Embedding and is considered a relative position method.
paras.zh: 无论如何，我们将在下面讨论的 RoPE 将这种相对关系直接构建到注意力计算中。RoPE 由 Su 等人在 2021 年的 RoFormer 论文中提出，代表旋转位置嵌入（Rotary Position Embedding），被认为是一种相对位置方法。

full.sec: 3.1 Moving the rotation inside attention in RoPE
full.secZh: 3.1 在 RoPE 中将旋转移入注意力机制内部

items.en: In attention, each token's current representation is projected into a query, a key, and a value vector. Query-key dot products determine attention scores. After masking and softmax, the resulting weights determine how the value vectors are mixed. For a refresher, see my article *Understanding and Coding Self-Attention, Multi-Head Attention, Causal-Attention, and Cross-Attention in LLMs*:
items.zh: 在注意力机制中，每个 token 当前的表示会被投影为 query、key 和 value 向量。query 与 key 的点积决定注意力分数。经过掩码和 softmax 之后，得到的权重决定 value 向量如何被混合。如需回顾，可参阅我的文章《理解并编码 LLM 中的自注意力、多头注意力、因果注意力与交叉注意力》：

items.capEn: RoPE uses the token’s position to rotate its query and key vectors before their dot product. The value vectors bypass this rotation. Figure 14 below shows an overview of where RoPE is applied in a relatively recent MiniMax-M3, where QK-Norm normalizes queries and keys before RoPE.
items.capZh: RoPE 使用 token 的位置在其点积之前旋转其 query 和 key 向量。value 向量绕过此旋转。下面的图 14 展示了在相对较新的 MiniMax-M3 中应用 RoPE 的概览，其中 QK-Norm 在 RoPE 之前对 query 和 key 进行归一化。

items.capEn: Figure 14: MiniMax-M3 applies RoPE to queries and keys inside attention.
items.capZh: 图 14：MiniMax-M3 在注意力内部对 query 和 key 应用 RoPE。

items.en: As shown in the figure above, the LLM architecture has no explicit position vector added alongside the initial token embedding. Its explicit position signal is injected inside attention instead.
items.zh: 如上图所示，LLM 架构并没有在初始 token 嵌入之外额外加入显式的位置向量。它的显式位置信号是注入到注意力机制内部的。

items.en: Side note: MiniMax-M3 rotates only part of each query and key head, a variation known as "partial RoPE" that we will cover later in Section 6.1. But to understand the basic RoPE operation first, let's walk through the method step by step using a small example.
items.zh: 旁注：MiniMax-M3 只对每个 query 和 key 头的一部分进行旋转，这种变体称为“部分 RoPE”，我们将在 6.1 节中进一步介绍。但为了先理解 RoPE 的基本操作，让我们用一个小例子逐步走一遍该方法。

full.sec: 3.2 From token representations to feature pairs in RoPE
full.secZh: 3.2 从词元表示到 RoPE 中的特征对

items.en: Attention usually divides its query, key, and value features into multiple heads, which are processed in parallel. Hence, the full mechanism is usually called Multi-head Attention (note that Grouped Query Attention also uses multiple heads). Here, each attention head computes its own attention scores and weighted sums. RoPE then acts on pairs of numbers within each query and key head.
items.zh: 注意力机制通常将其查询、键和值特征划分为多个头，并行处理。因此，整个机制通常被称为多头注意力（注意，分组查询注意力也使用多个头）。在这里，每个注意力头计算自己的注意力分数和加权和。然后，RoPE 作用于每个查询头和键头内的数字对。

items.en: To make this concrete, Figure 12 below follows a token representation through the learned query and key projections, which are computed via the weight matrices \(W_Q\) and \(W_K\). In this toy example, each projection produces 16 features, which are reshaped into two heads with eight features each. In the figure below, every small cell contains one scalar feature, meaning one numerical entry in a vector (the numbers are not shown due to space reasons).
items.zh: 为了具体说明，下面的图 12 展示了一个词元表示经过学习到的查询和键投影的过程，这些投影通过权重矩阵 \(W_Q\) 和 \(W_K\) 计算。在这个玩具示例中，每个投影产生 16 个特征，这些特征被重塑为两个头，每个头有八个特征。在下图中，每个小单元格包含一个标量特征，即向量中的一个数值条目（由于空间原因，数字未显示）。

items.capEn: Figure 15: Projecting a hidden state, reshaping into heads, and pairing features for RoPE.
items.capZh: 图 15：投影隐藏状态，重塑为多个头，并为 RoPE 配对特征。

items.en: For the first eight-feature head, [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], we pair each feature in the first half with the corresponding feature in the second half. This gives (1, 5), (2, 6), (3, 7), and (4, 8). This _split-half_ convention is used in LLM implementations, including my Qwen3 implementation. (We will compare it with the original, alternative adjacent-feature pairing method later after implementing the basic operation.)
items.zh: 对于第一个八特征头 [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]，我们将前半部分的每个特征与后半部分对应的特征配对。这得到 (1, 5)、(2, 6)、(3, 7) 和 (4, 8)。这种 _分半_ 约定用于 LLM 实现，包括我的 Qwen3 实现。（我们将在实现基本操作后，将其与原始的、替代的相邻特征配对方法进行比较。）

items.en: Each pair gets a rotation angle determined by the token position \(m\) and that pair’s frequency \(\theta_i\). The corresponding query and key pairs use the same frequency. Figure 16 below shows how we rotate the pairs, put the updated features back in their original locations, and compute the query-key dot product.
items.zh: 每一对得到一个旋转角度，该角度由词元位置 \(m\) 和该对的频率 \(\theta_i\) 决定。对应的查询和键对使用相同的频率。下面的图 16 展示了我们如何旋转这些对，将更新后的特征放回其原始位置，并计算查询-键点积。

items.capEn: Figure 16: Pairwise rotations produce the rotated query and key vectors used to compute attention scores.
items.capZh: 图 16：成对旋转生成用于计算注意力分数的旋转查询向量和键向量。

items.en: The next section will walk through the figure(s) a bit more slowly.
items.zh: 下一节将更缓慢地逐一讲解这些图。

full.secZh: 3.3 在 RoPE 中旋转一对

items.en: For the following example, we'll use the same two positions as before. The query comes from "the" at position _m_ = 5, and the key comes from the first "fox" at position _n_ = 2. Since, in this example, the key comes before the query, the causal mask allows the query to attend to it.
items.zh: 在下面的示例中，我们将沿用之前的两个位置。查询来自位置 _m_ = 5 处的“the”，键来自位置 _n_ = 2 处的第一个“fox”。由于在本例中键位于查询之前，因果掩码允许查询关注到它。

items.en: To illustrate the effect that the position has, and keeping everything fixed, let's assume we start both pairs from the same two values, (1, 5).
items.zh: 为了说明位置所产生的影响，并保持其他一切不变，我们假设两个对都从相同的两个值 (1, 5) 出发。

items.capEn: Figure 17: The first feature pair, (1, 5), takes one entry from each half of the query head.
items.capZh: 图 17：第一个特征对(1, 5)从查询头的每一半中各取一个条目。

items.en: Furthermore, for this example, let's use _θ_ = 20° per token position (_π_/9 radians per position). At position 2, we rotate the key's arrow counterclockwise by 2 × 20° = 40°. At position 5, we rotate the query's arrow by 5 × 20° = 100°.

```
import torch

query_head = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3., 4., 5., 6., 7., 8.])
key_head = query_head.clone()

# Split-half pairing gives (1, 5), (2, 6), (3, 7), and (4, 8).
query_pairs = torch.stack(query_head.chunk(2), dim=-1)
key_pairs = torch.stack(key_head.chunk(2), dim=-1)

# Take the first feature pair from each head.
q = query_pairs[0]
k = key_pairs[0]

m = 5  # Query position (in our example, "the")
n = 2  # Key position (in our example, the first "fox")
theta = torch.deg2rad(torch.tensor(20.0))  # Radians per token position

def rotate_pair(pair, angle):
    a, b = pair
    c, s = torch.cos(angle), torch.sin(angle)
    return torch.stack((a * c - b * s, a * s + b * c))

k_rot = rotate_pair(k, n * theta)  # 2 × 20° = 40°
q_rot = rotate_pair(q, m * theta)  # 5 × 20° = 100°

print(f"Original key:   ({k[0]:g}, {k[1]:g})")
print(f"Original query: ({q[0]:g}, {q[1]:g})")
print(f"Rotated key:    ({k_rot[0]:.3f}, {k_rot[1]:.3f})")
print(f"Rotated query:  ({q_rot[0]:.3f}, {q_rot[1]:.3f})")
```

For simplicity here we’ll follow just the first pair in each head, (1, 5), formed by taking the entries at indices 0 and 4:

items.en: As shown above, in our example, those entries have values (1, 5) in both heads before the rotation.
items.zh: 如上所示，在我们的例子中，这些条目在旋转前在两个头中的值均为 (1, 5)。

items.en: Also, as in the code above, let’s use the notation \(q = (q_1, q_2)\) and \(k = (k_1, k_2)\) for these two pairs. To compute their dot product, using the standard dot product formula, we multiply corresponding coordinates and add the products:
items.zh: 此外，如上面的代码所示，让我们用 \(q = (q_1, q_2)\) 和 \(k = (k_1, k_2)\) 表示这两对。为了计算它们的点积，使用标准点积公式，我们将对应坐标相乘并相加：

items.capEn: Before rotation, the pairs have a dot product of 1 × 1 + 5 × 5 = 26. Using the rounded coordinates from the previous Figure 18 gives the contribution from the first pair after rotation:
items.capZh: 旋转前，这些对的点积为 1 × 1 + 5 × 5 = 26。使用图 18 中四舍五入的坐标，可得到旋转后第一对的贡献：

items.capEn: We can see why by writing the dot product in terms of the lengths of the two vectors (arrows in Figure 18) and the angle _ϕ_ between them.
items.capZh: 我们可以通过用两个向量的长度（图 18 中的箭头）和它们之间的夹角_ϕ_来表示点积，从而理解原因。

items.capEn: In both cases, the vector length is √26. The query (position 5) is rotated by 100° and the key (position 2) is rotated by 40°. The vectors (arrows) start from the same direction, so they end up being 60° apart after rotation. Their exact dot product is 26 × cos(60°) = 13.
items.capZh: 在两种情况下，向量长度均为√26。查询（位置 5）旋转 100°，键（位置 2）旋转 40°。向量（箭头）从相同方向出发，因此旋转后它们最终相隔 60°。它们的精确点积为 26 × cos(60°) = 13。

items.en: Now let’s see what happens if we move just the key from position 2 to position 3, but we keep its starting coordinates (1, 5) fixed. The key’s rotation changes now from \(2 \times 20^\circ = 40^\circ\) to \(3 \times 20^\circ = 60^\circ\). The query still rotates by \(100^\circ\), so the angle between the arrows shrinks to \(40^\circ\) and the dot product changes from 13 to \(26 \times \cos(40^\circ) \approx 19.92\). So, moving the key one position closer changed the dot product even though we started with the same feature values.
items.zh: 现在让我们看看，如果只将键从位置 2 移动到位置 3，但保持其起始坐标 (1, 5) 不变，会发生什么。键的旋转角度从 \(2 \times 20^\circ = 40^\circ\) 变为 \(3 \times 20^\circ = 60^\circ\)。查询仍然旋转 \(100^\circ\)，因此箭头之间的夹角缩小到 \(40^\circ\)，点积从 13 变为 \(26 \times \cos(40^\circ) \approx 19.92\)。因此，即使我们从相同的特征值开始，将键移动一个位置也会改变点积。

items.en: Why do these dot products matter? In attention, we sum the contributions from all feature pairs to get the query-key dot products. RoPE can change those dot products and thus the weights that softmax assigns to the value vectors.
items.zh: 为什么这些点积很重要？在注意力机制中，我们将所有特征对的贡献相加以得到查询-键点积。RoPE 可以改变这些点积，从而改变 softmax 分配给值向量的权重。

items.capEn: In the attention equation above, _Q′_ and _K′_ are matrices that contain the rotated queries _q′_ and keys _k′_ for one head, _V_ contains the values, and _d_ is the head dimension.
items.capZh: 在上述注意力方程中，_Q′_ 和 _K′_ 是包含单个头的旋转查询 _q′_ 和键 _k′_ 的矩阵，_V_ 包含值，_d_ 是头维度。

full.sec: 3.5 Why shifting both positions preserves the attention score in RoPE
full.secZh: 3.5 为什么在 RoPE 中同时平移两个位置能保持注意力分数

items.en: Now that we have illustrated the computation of the dot products, which is at the core of the attention mechanism, let's return to positions _m_ = 5 and _n_ = 2. If we shift both positions to the right by three positions, we get _m_ = 8 and _n_ = 5. Each rotation gains 60° (the query goes from 100° to 160°, and the key goes from 40° to 100°); however, the angle between the vectors stays the same. The dot product for this feature pair is still 13.
items.zh: 现在我们已经说明了点积的计算，这是注意力机制的核心，让我们回到位置 _m_ = 5 和 _n_ = 2。如果我们将两个位置都向右移动三个位置，我们得到 _m_ = 8 和 _n_ = 5。每个旋转增加了 60°（查询从 100° 到 160°，键从 40° 到 100°）；然而，向量之间的夹角保持不变。这个特征对的点积仍然是 13。

items.capEn: Figure 19: The first pair’s dot product at three different position settings.
items.capZh: 图 19：第一对在三种不同位置设置下的点积。

items.en: The key is that the difference between the rotation angles is
items.zh: 关键在于旋转角度之间的差是

items.capEn: If we keep the original query and key vectors fixed and shift both token positions by the same amount, RoPE adds the same rotation to both vectors. The angle between them stays the same, so their dot product stays the same. Note that Figure 20 below uses smaller angles than the actual example (20° per position) to keep the picture readable.
items.capZh: 如果我们保持原始查询和键向量固定，并将两个 token 位置平移相同的量，RoPE 会对两个向量施加相同的旋转。它们之间的夹角保持不变，因此它们的点积保持不变。注意，下面的图 20 使用了比实际示例（每个位置 20°）更小的角度，以保持图片可读。

items.capEn: Figure 20: A shared position shift preserves the relative angle and dot product for fixed query and key features.
items.capZh: 图 20：共享位置平移在固定查询和键特征下保持了相对角度和点积。

items.en: The examples above and Figure 20 illustrate the main idea behind RoPE. We use each token's position to rotate the corresponding query and key in the attention module. In the query-key dot product, what matters is how much one vector rotates relative to the other. For each feature pair, this difference in rotation depends only on the offset between the two tokens.
items.zh: 上述例子和图 20 说明了 RoPE 背后的主要思想。我们使用每个 token 的位置来旋转注意力模块中对应的查询和键。在查询-键点积中，重要的是一个向量相对于另一个向量旋转了多少。对于每个特征对，这种旋转差异只取决于两个 token 之间的偏移量。

items.en: To illustrate this in the big picture context, in Figure 21, each row collects the scores for one query. If we consider row 5, the query for “the”, and column 2, the key for “fox”, the attention score between those two is computed as the dot product between the two rotated versions of the query and key vector.
items.zh: 为了在整体背景下说明这一点，在图 21 中，每一行收集了一个查询的分数。如果我们考虑第 5 行（“the”的查询）和第 2 列（“fox”的键），那么这两者之间的注意力分数计算为查询和键向量的两个旋转版本之间的点积。

items.capEn: Figure 21: The attention scores for one head before softmax. Gray cells mark future keys excluded by the causal mask.
items.capZh: 图 21：softmax 之前单个头的注意力分数。灰色单元格标记被因果掩码排除的未来键。

items.en: What's the point, again? Let's once more consider “The red fox jumps over the gray fox.” If we add 100 tokens (e.g., think system prompt) before the sentence, the first “fox” and the second “the” move from positions 2 and 5 to 102 and 105. However, a prefix of any length shifts both positions equally, so they still stay exactly three positions apart. This means each vector (arrow) gains the exact same additional rotation, which preserves the angle between them and their dot product (assuming we hold the unrotated query and key vectors fixed; in a real model, a new prefix of 100 tokens can change those vectors by changing what the tokens attend to).
items.zh: 重点是什么？让我们再次考虑“The red fox jumps over the gray fox.”。如果我们在句子前添加 100 个 token（例如，系统提示），第一个“fox”和第二个“the”从位置 2 和 5 移动到 102 和 105。然而，任何长度的前缀都会平等地移动两个位置，因此它们仍然恰好相隔三个位置。这意味着每个向量（箭头）获得完全相同的额外旋转，这保持了它们之间的夹角和它们的点积（假设我们保持未旋转的查询和键向量固定；在真实模型中，新的 100 个 token 的前缀可以通过改变 token 关注的内容来改变这些向量）。

items.en: Figure 22 tracks this comparison in the attention score matrix. The right panel shows the rows and columns for the sentence after we add the prefix. In our toy example, the first pair still contributes 13 to the dot product.
items.zh: 图 22 在注意力分数矩阵中追踪了这一比较。右侧面板展示了添加前缀后句子的行和列。在我们的玩具示例中，第一对仍然对点积贡献 13。

items.capEn: Figure 22: The highlighted score moves from row 5, column 2 to row 105, column 102. It keeps the same value if we hold the query and key vectors fixed before rotation.
items.capZh: 图 22：高亮的分数从第 5 行第 2 列移动到第 105 行第 102 列。如果我们在旋转前保持查询和键向量固定，它保持相同的值。

items.en: As you may recall, in the original transformer's sinusoidal encoding, a fixed offset also corresponds to a fixed rotation within each sine/cosine pair. But that shared rotation applies only to the position vectors (added to the input vector) instead of the key and query vectors inside the attention mechanism.
items.zh: 你可能还记得，在原始 Transformer 的正弦编码中，固定偏移也对应于每个正弦/余弦对内的固定旋转。但这种共享旋转仅适用于位置向量（添加到输入向量），而不是注意力机制内部的键向量和查询向量。

items.zh: 图 23 比较了这种平移在我们迄今涵盖的三种方法中所带来的变化。

items.capZh: 图 23：在正弦编码、GPT-2 的学习位置嵌入和 RoPE 下的相同位置平移。

full.secZh: 5.1 计算并应用旋转

items.en: First, let's reuse the 8-feature query from Figure 24. For convenience, below are its four feature pairs before rotation.
items.zh: 首先，让我们复用图 24 中的 8 维特征查询。为方便起见，下面给出其在旋转前的四组特征对。

items.capEn: Detail from Figure 24. The eight query features form four pairs in the split-half layout.
items.capZh: 图 24 的细节。八个查询特征在半分割布局中形成四对。

items.en: In the earlier non-coding example, we chose a frequency of 20° per token position for the first pair to keep the math simple. Here, we'll use the original RoPE formula from the previous Section 4 above, \(\theta_i = b^{-2i/d}\), with head dimension \(d = 8\) and base \(b = 10{,}000\).
items.zh: 在之前的非编码示例中，为保持数学简洁，我们为第一组特征对选择了每个 token 位置 20° 的频率。这里，我们将使用上文第 4 节中的原始 RoPE 公式 \(\theta_i = b^{-2i/d}\)，其中头维度 \(d = 8\)，基数 \(b = 10{,}000\)。

items.en: Figure 26 shows how the two functions work together to apply these rotations.
items.zh: 图 26 展示了这两个函数如何协同工作以应用这些旋转。

items.capEn: Figure 26: _rope\_params_ returns the cosine and sine tables for token position 2. _rope\_split\_half_ takes those tables and the original query and returns the rotated query.
items.capZh: 图 26：_rope\_params_ 返回 token 位置 2 的余弦和正弦表。_rope\_split\_half_ 接收这些表和原始查询，并返回旋转后的查询。

items.en: As shown in the figure above, first, rope_params determines how far to rotate each pair, returning two "tables" that store the cosine and sine of those angles. Or, in other words, rope_params computes the cosine and sine of each rotation angle, which depends on the token's position and the feature pair's frequency.
items.zh: 如上图所示，首先，rope_params 确定每组特征对需要旋转的角度，并返回两个存储这些角度余弦值和正弦值的“表”。换言之，rope_params 计算每个旋转角的余弦和正弦，而该角度取决于 token 的位置和特征对的频率。

items.en:
```
import torch

def rope_params(head_dim, positions, base=10_000):
    assert head_dim % 2 == 0
    indices = torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2, device=positions.device)
    inv_freq = base ** (-indices.float() / head_dim)
    angles = positions.float()[:, None] * inv_freq[None, :]
    return angles.cos(), angles.sin()
```
items.zh:
```
import torch

def rope_params(head_dim, positions, base=10_000):
    assert head_dim % 2 == 0
    indices = torch.arange(0, head_dim, 2, device=positions.device)
    inv_freq = base ** (-indices.float() / head_dim)
    angles = positions.float()[:, None] * inv_freq[None, :]
    return angles.cos(), angles.sin()
```

items.en: The indices array in the rope_params function contains the \(2i\) values from the frequency formula in Section 4:
items.zh: rope_params 函数中的 indices 数组包含第 4 节频率公式中的 \(2i\) 值：

items.capEn: For our eight-feature query, the `indices`are `[0, 2, 4, 6]`, that is, one 2 _i_ value for each feature pair. Suppose we use the common base _b_ = 10,000. And following our earlier examples, we choose a small head dimension of _d_ = 8. In this case, the `inv_freq` then computes the four pair frequencies _θ i_ = _b_−2 _i_/_d_ as follows:
items.capZh: 对于我们的八特征查询，`indices` 为 `[0, 2, 4, 6]`，即每个特征对一个 2 _i_ 值。假设我们使用常见基数 _b_ = 10,000。并沿用之前的示例，我们选择较小的头维度 _d_ = 8。此时，`inv_freq` 计算四个对频率 _θ i_ = _b_−2 _i_/_d_ 如下：

items.en: As we can see above, the resulting inv_freq has one frequency \(_θ_i_\) for each of the four feature pairs (measured in radians) per token position.
items.zh: 如上所示，得到的 inv_freq 为每个 token 位置上的四个特征对各包含一个频率 \(_θ_i_\)（以弧度为单位）。

items.en: Next, the angles then multiplies each pair's frequency \(_θ_i_\) with the token position \(_m_\), which computes the rotation angle \(_mθ_i_\). In our example, with positions = [2], we get:
items.zh: 接下来，angles 将每个特征对的频率 \(_θ_i_\) 与 token 位置 \(_m_\) 相乘，从而计算出旋转角 \(_mθ_i_\)。在我们的示例中，positions = [2]，得到：

items.en: Finally, rope_params takes the cosine and sine of each angle and outputs them as two so-called cosine and sine tables, cos and sin. In both tables, each row is a token position and each column is a feature pair. Since we only use token position 2 here, each table has shape (1, 4), with the single row shown below:
items.zh: 最后，rope_params 对每个角度取余弦和正弦，并将它们输出为两个所谓的余弦表和正弦表，即 cos 和 sin。在这两个表中，每一行对应一个 token 位置，每一列对应一个特征对。由于此处我们只使用 token 位置 2，因此每个表的形状为 (1, 4)，其中唯一的一行如下所示：

items.en: For the example in Figure 26, each table has one row for token position 2 and four columns, one for each feature pair. Figure 27 shows the rotation angle for each pair and the corresponding entries in the two tables.
items.zh: 对于图 26 中的示例，每个表有一行对应 token 位置 2，四列分别对应一个特征对。图 27 展示了每个特征对的旋转角以及两个表中对应的条目。

items.capEn: Figure 27: _The_ two tables returned by _rope\_params_ for token position 2. _The_ highlighted column gives the cosine and sine used to rotate the first feature pair, _(1, 5)_.
items.capZh: 图 27：_rope\_params_ 为 token 位置 2 返回的两个表。高亮列给出用于旋转第一个特征对 _(1, 5)_ 的余弦和正弦。

items.en: In short, rope_params computes the cosine and sine of each rotation angle, which depends on the token's position and the feature pair's frequency.
items.zh: 简而言之，rope_params 计算每个旋转角的余弦和正弦，而旋转角取决于 token 的位置和特征对的频率。

items.en: In a real-world scenario, if we pass `rope_params` 1,024 token positions for a context size of 1024, and a head dimension of 128, it returns two tensors, `cos` and `sin`, each with shape (1024, 64) since a head with 128 features has 64 pairs.
items.zh: 在实际场景中，如果我们为上下文大小 1024 传入 `rope_params` 的 1,024 个 token 位置，且头维度为 128，它会返回两个张量 `cos` 和 `sin`，每个形状为 (1024, 64)，因为具有 128 个特征的头有 64 对。

items.en: The tables have no batch or head dimension, and we broadcast each (1024, 64) table across the batch and head dimensions. So, if we have multi-head attention or grouped query attention with 32 heads, feature pair 0 at token position 2 uses the same rotation angle in all 32 heads. Each head rotates its own feature values, so the rotated queries can still differ across heads. Also, the same entries can be reused across queries, keys, and heads that use the same positions and frequencies. In short, we only need to (pre)compute these tables once per model for all positions up to a maximum supported context size.
items.zh: 这些表没有批次或头维度，我们将每个 (1024, 64) 表广播到批次和头维度上。因此，如果我们有 32 个头的多头注意力机制或分组查询注意力机制，token 位置 2 处的特征对 0 在所有 32 个头中使用相同的旋转角度。每个头旋转自己的特征值，因此旋转后的查询在不同头之间仍可不同。此外，相同的条目可以在使用相同位置和频率的查询、键和头之间复用。简而言之，我们只需为每个模型对所有位置（直至最大支持的上下文窗口大小）（预）计算这些表一次。

items.en: Technically, it would also be possible to store these tables alongside the model weights; but they are so incredibly cheap to compute that storing them on disk would be overkill.
items.zh: 从技术上讲，也可以将这些表与模型权重一起存储；但它们的计算成本极低，将其存储在磁盘上属于过度设计。

items.en: Next, `rope_split_half` uses those cosines and sines to rotate the actual features in the query and key vectors inside attention.
items.zh: 接下来，`rope_split_half` 使用这些余弦和正弦来旋转注意力机制内部查询和键向量中的实际特征。

items.en: Considering the simple 8-feature example once more, the `.chunk` in the code snippet above splits the query into [1, 2, 3, 4] and [5, 6, 7, 8] and lines up the two entries in each pair. For example, the first slot of each half gives us (1, 5), the second (2, 6), and so on. The two expressions inside `torch.cat` compute the rotated halves using the equations from Section 3.3:
items.zh: 再次考虑简单的 8 特征示例，上述代码片段中的 `.chunk` 将查询拆分为 [1, 2, 3, 4] 和 [5, 6, 7, 8]，并将每对中的两个条目对齐。例如，每个半部分的第一槽给出 (1, 5)，第二槽给出 (2, 6)，依此类推。`torch.cat` 内部的两个表达式使用第 3.3 节的方程计算旋转后的半部分：

items.capEn: Note that here, everything denoted with _a i_ corresponds to the first half of the query, and everything denoted with _b i_ comes from the second half. The first expression inside `torch.cat` computes all the _a i′_ values, and the second computes all the _b i′_ values.
items.capZh: 注意，此处所有以 _a i_ 表示的内容对应查询的前半部分，所有以 _b i_ 表示的内容来自后半部分。`torch.cat` 内的第一个表达式计算所有 _a i′_ 值，第二个计算所有 _b i′_ 值。

items.en: Then, we concatenate the halves, which puts each value back in its original index position via torch.cat.
items.zh: 然后，我们将两半拼接起来，通过 torch.cat 把每个值放回其原始索引位置。

items.en: Here's the code that produces the rotated query in the earlier Figure 26. The shown reshape (1, 1, 1, 8) just brings the simple toy array into the expected format: one batch item, one head, one token, and eight features.
items.zh: 下面是生成前面图 26 中旋转后 query 的代码。所示的 reshape (1, 1, 1, 8) 只是将简单的玩具数组转换为预期格式：一个批次项、一个注意力头、一个 token 和八个特征。

items.en:
```
positions = torch.tensor([2])
cos, sin = rope_params(8, positions)

q = torch.arange(1., 9.).reshape(1, 1, 1, 8)
q_rot = rope_split_half(q, cos, sin)
print(q_rot[0, 0, 0])
```
items.zh:
```
positions = torch.tensor([2])
cos, sin = rope_params(8, positions)

q = torch.arange(1., 9.).reshape(1, 1, 1, 8)
q_rot = rope_split_half(q, cos, sin)
print(q_rot[0, 0, 0])
```

items.en: With several positions, each token simply picks up its own row from the cos and sin tables. Through broadcasting, PyTorch reuses these same tables across all batch items and attention heads.
items.zh: 在存在多个位置时，每个 token 只需从 cos 和 sin 表中取出自己对应的那一行。通过广播机制，PyTorch 会在所有批次项和注意力头之间复用这些相同的表。

full.secZh: 5.2 在因果注意力机制中使用 RoPE

paras.en: So far, we have coded the RoPE utility functions. Let's now use it in the real context, the attention mechanism. Here, we use the standard frequency schedule for two 8-feature heads and four token positions. We use random query, key, and value tensors to keep the example self-contained, but as mentioned before, you can optionally also check the end-to-end Qwen3 from-scratch implementation with real query, key, and values produced by the pre-trained model.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，我们已经编写了 RoPE 工具函数。现在让我们在真实的上下文中使用它，即注意力机制。这里，我们为两个 8 特征头和四个 token 位置使用标准的频率调度。我们使用随机的 query、key 和 value 张量以保持示例自包含，但如前所述，你也可以选择性地检查端到端的 Qwen3 从零实现，其中使用预训练模型产生的真实 query、key 和 value。

paras.en:
```
torch.manual_seed(123)

q = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8) # 1 batch, 2 heads, 4 tokens, 8 head dim
k = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8)
v = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8)
positions = torch.arange(4)

cos, sin = rope_params(8, positions)
q_rot = rope_split_half(q, cos, sin)
k_rot = rope_split_half(k, cos, sin)
scores = q_rot @ k_rot.transpose(-2, -1) / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5

future_mask = positions[None, :] > positions[:, None]
masked_scores = scores.masked_fill(future_mask, -torch.inf)
weights = torch.softmax(masked_scores, dim=-1)
context = weights @ v
```
paras.zh:
```
torch.manual_seed(123)

q = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8) # 1 batch, 2 heads, 4 tokens, 8 head dim
k = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8)
v = torch.randn(1, 2, 4, 8)
positions = torch.arange(4)

cos, sin = rope_params(8, positions)
q_rot = rope_split_half(q, cos, sin)
k_rot = rope_split_half(k, cos, sin)
scores = q_rot @ k_rot.transpose(-2, -1) / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5

future_mask = positions[None, :] > positions[:, None]
masked_scores = scores.masked_fill(future_mask, -torch.inf)
weights = torch.softmax(masked_scores, dim=-1)
context = weights @ v
```

paras.en: Note that only q and k, but not v, pass through RoPE. The resulting raw attention scores are stored in a tensor of shape (1, 2, 4, 4), that is, one row for each query position, and a column for each key position, and 4x4 since we have four tokens where each attends to each other.
paras.zh: 注意，只有 q 和 k 经过 RoPE，而 v 不经过。得到的原始注意力分数存储在一个形状为 (1, 2, 4, 4) 的张量中，即每个 query 位置一行，每个 key 位置一列，4x4 是因为我们有四个 token，每个 token 都关注其他每个 token。

paras.en: Then, using a conventional attention code implementation, the causal mask replaces the scores for future keys with negative infinity, so they get zeroed after the softmax. The resulting context tensor has shape (1, 2, 4, 8); the 4 because we have four tokens, and the 8 because the embedding dimension was originally 8.
paras.zh: 然后，使用常规的注意力代码实现，因果掩码将未来 key 的分数替换为负无穷，因此它们在 softmax 之后被置零。得到的上下文张量形状为 (1, 2, 4, 8)；4 是因为我们有四个 token，8 是因为嵌入维度原本是 8。

paras.en: We can also check that our claim about relative offsets holds, meaning that adding 3 to each position should change the position but preserve the query-key offsets:
paras.zh: 我们还可以检查关于相对偏移的说法是否成立，即给每个位置加 3 应该改变位置但保持 query-key 偏移不变：

paras.en:
```
cos_shifted, sin_shifted = rope_params(8, positions + 3)
q_shifted = rope_split_half(q, cos_shifted, sin_shifted)
k_shifted = rope_split_half(k, cos_shifted, sin_shifted)
scores_shifted = (
    q_shifted @ k_shifted.transpose(-2, -1) / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5
)
torch.testing.assert_close(scores, scores_shifted)
# Should return True
```
paras.zh:
```
cos_shifted, sin_shifted = rope_params(8, positions + 3)
q_shifted = rope_split_half(q, cos_shifted, sin_shifted)
k_shifted = rope_split_half(k, cos_shifted, sin_shifted)
scores_shifted = (
    q_shifted @ k_shifted.transpose(-2, -1) / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5
)
torch.testing.assert_close(scores, scores_shifted)
# Should return True
```

full.secZh: 5.3 另一种特征配对约定

items.en: I mentioned the _split-halves_ convention many times throughout this article. The original RoPE paper uses the alternative _interleaved_ convention, as does the original LLaMA implementation (but as mentioned before, most code implementations now use the split-halves, because it makes it easier, in code, to rotate all pairs at once with element-wise sine and cosine operations.)
items.zh: 在本文中，我多次提到了**分半**约定。原始的 RoPE 论文使用了另一种**交错**约定，原始的 LLaMA 实现也是如此（但如前所述，现在大多数代码实现使用分半约定，因为在代码中，通过逐元素的 sine 和 cosine 操作，可以更容易地一次性旋转所有对。）

items.en: To illustrate the difference between the two layouts, Figure 28 below uses the same 8-feature vector in both rows.
items.zh: 为了说明两种布局的区别，下面的图 28 在两行中使用了相同的 8 维特征向量。

items.capEn: Figure 28: Split-half pairs each feature in the first half with the corresponding feature in the second half. Interleaved pairs adjacent features.
items.capZh: 图 28：半分割对将前半部分的每个特征与后半部分的对应特征配对。交错对将相邻特征配对。

items.en: The interleaved implementation uses the same two equations, but selects alternating features and interleaves the outputs.
items.zh: 交错实现使用相同的两个公式，但选择交替的特征并将输出交错。

items.en: But mathematically, the layouts are equivalent when we account for the feature order. So, rearranging the entries [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] to [1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8] makes the split-half pairs adjacent with pairs (1, 5), (2, 6), and so on. If we apply the same rearrangement to both queries and keys, it results in identical dot products.
items.zh: 但在数学上，当我们考虑特征顺序时，这两种布局是等价的。因此，将条目 [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8] 重新排列为 [1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8] 使得分半对相邻，即 (1, 5), (2, 6) 等。如果我们对查询和键都应用相同的重排，则会得到相同的点积。

items.en:
```
order = torch.tensor([0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7], device=q.device)
q_rot_interleaved = rope_interleaved(q[..., order], cos, sin)
k_rot_interleaved = rope_interleaved(k[..., order], cos, sin)
scores_interleaved = (
    q_rot_interleaved @ k_rot_interleaved.transpose(-2, -1)
    / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5
)

torch.testing.assert_close(q_rot[..., order], q_rot_interleaved)
torch.testing.assert_close(k_rot[..., order], k_rot_interleaved)
torch.testing.assert_close(scores, scores_interleaved)
# This should all return True
```
items.zh:
```
order = torch.tensor([0, 4, 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7], device=q.device)
q_rot_interleaved = rope_interleaved(q[..., order], cos, sin)
k_rot_interleaved = rope_interleaved(k[..., order], cos, sin)
scores_interleaved = (
    q_rot_interleaved @ k_rot_interleaved.transpose(-2, -1)
    / q.shape[-1] ** 0.5
)

torch.testing.assert_close(q_rot[..., order], q_rot_interleaved)
torch.testing.assert_close(k_rot[..., order], k_rot_interleaved)
torch.testing.assert_close(scores, scores_interleaved)
# This should all return True
```

items.en: The outputs retain the reordered features, so we compare them with the split-half outputs in that same order. Applying the two layouts to the original vector however would give different scores.
items.zh: 输出保留了重排后的特征，因此我们以相同的顺序与分半输出进行比较。然而，将两种布局应用于原始向量会得到不同的分数。

full.secZh: 6. 现代架构中的位置选择

paras.en: RoPE has been a staple in most (open-weight) LLMs since the original LLaMA model. Of course, proprietary models may use it as well, but it's always hard to say anything with 100% certainty about proprietary models.
paras.zh: 自最初的 LLaMA 模型以来，RoPE 一直是大多数（开放权重）LLM 中的主要方法。当然，专有模型也可能使用它，但对于专有模型，总是很难百分之百确定。

paras.en: However, in recent years, many architectures have been moving away from full-blown RoPE in every transformer block. In the following subsection, we will discuss some of these variants.
paras.zh: 然而，近年来，许多架构已经不再在每个 Transformer 块中使用完整的 RoPE。在接下来的小节中，我们将讨论其中一些变体。

paras.en: For instance, the full RoPE implementation we discussed and implemented in the sections above rotates _every_ feature pair in _every_ query and key head.
paras.zh: 例如，我们在上文讨论并实现的完整 RoPE 实现会旋转**每个**查询头和键头中的**每个**特征对。

paras.en: In the following examples in the subsections above and below, we will see that models only rotate some features within a head, other models skip RoPE in some transformer blocks, and some models use a different approach and add position information directly to their attention scores.
paras.zh: 在上下小节中的以下示例中，我们将看到模型仅旋转头内的部分特征，其他模型在某些 Transformer 块中跳过 RoPE，还有一些模型使用不同的方法，直接将位置信息添加到注意力分数中。

full.secZh: 6.1 部分旋转位置编码（Partial RoPE）

items.en: As discussed throughout the article, regular "full" RoPE rotates all dimensions in each query and key head. Partial RoPE is a variant that rotates only a subset, while leaving the remaining dimensions unchanged.
items.zh: 正如本文通篇所讨论的，常规的“全”RoPE 会旋转每个查询头和键头中的所有维度。部分 RoPE 是一种变体，它只旋转一部分维度，而保持其余维度不变。

items.en: For example, MiniMax-M3's configuration uses 64 rotary dimensions within each 128-dimensional head. That gives 32 rotated feature pairs and 64 unchanged dimensions. The figure below illustrates how that looks like.
items.zh: 例如，MiniMax-M3 的配置在每个 128 维的头中使用 64 个旋转维度。这产生了 32 个旋转特征对和 64 个未改变的维度。下图展示了其外观。

items.capEn: Figure 29: Full RoPE and partial RoPE in a 128-dimensional head.
items.capZh: 图 29：128 维头中的完整 RoPE 和部分 RoPE。

items.en: Note that if we look past the first transformer block, the unrotated features can still contain position information inherited from earlier transformer blocks.
items.zh: 请注意，如果我们越过第一个 Transformer 块，未旋转的特征仍然可以包含从先前 Transformer 块继承的位置信息。

items.en: Anyways, what's the point behind partial RoPE? It saves some memory. For example, in the MiniMax-M3 example above, rotating half the features reduces the size of the precomputed cosine and sine tables also in half. So, with partial RoPE, instead of 64 columns, now each table only needs 32 columns. However, note that the KV cache still stores the full key and value vectors for each cached token.
items.zh: 无论如何，部分 RoPE 背后的意义是什么？它节省了一些内存。例如，在上面的 MiniMax-M3 示例中，旋转一半的特征也将预计算的余弦和正弦表的大小减半。因此，使用部分 RoPE 时，每个表只需要 32 列，而不是 64 列。然而，请注意，KV 缓存仍然为每个缓存 token 存储完整的键和值向量。

items.en: For MiniMax-M3's 1M-token context, rotating 64 of the 128 features halves the size of the precomputed cosine and sine tables, saving 0.134 GB (128 MiB) if the tables are stored in BF16. If the tables themselves were stored in NVFP4, the savings would be 0.038 GB (36 MiB), including the block scales.
items.zh: 对于 MiniMax-M3 的 1M token 上下文，旋转 128 个特征中的 64 个将预计算的余弦和正弦表的大小减半，如果表以 BF16 存储，则节省 0.134 GB（128 MiB）。如果表本身以 NVFP4 存储，则节省 0.038 GB（36 MiB），包括块缩放因子。

items.en: Note that in experiments with 1B to 8B models, the _Fractional Rotation, Full Potential?_ paper found that rotating around 10% of each head's features often gave similar training loss and benchmark accuracy to full RoPE. However, full RoPE did better on some evaluations.
items.zh: 需要注意的是，在 1B 到 8B 模型的实验中，_Fractional Rotation, Full Potential?_ 论文发现，对每个注意力头约 10% 的特征进行旋转，其训练损失和基准准确率往往与完整 RoPE 相近。不过，完整 RoPE 在某些评测上表现更好。

items.en: So, in my opinion, partial RoPE is hardly worth it.
items.zh: 因此，在我看来，部分 RoPE 几乎不值得采用。

full.secZh: 6.2 NoPE 层

items.en: NoPE was coined in the paper *The Impact of Positional Encoding on Length Generalization in Transformers* and means _no explicit positional encoding_. The idea, or observation, is that an attention layer without any explicit position method still has a causal mask, where a query can attend only to itself and earlier tokens. And this causal masking implicitly provides positional information.
items.zh: NoPE 一词出自论文 *The Impact of Positional Encoding on Length Generalization in Transformers*，意为_不使用显式位置编码_。其思想（或观察）是：一个不采用任何显式位置方法的注意力层仍然具有因果掩码，其中查询只能关注自身及更早的词元。而这种因果掩码隐式地提供了位置信息。

items.en: Let's use the first four tokens from our earlier example, *The red fox jumps*. In Figure 30, the query for *fox* at position 2 can attend to *The*, *red*, and itself. The query for *red* at position 1 can attend to *The* and itself.
items.zh: 让我们用前面例子中的前四个词元，*The red fox jumps*。在图 30 中，位置 2 处 *fox* 的查询可以关注 *The*、*red* 以及自身。位置 1 处 *red* 的查询可以关注 *The* 以及自身。

items.capEn: Figure 30: Example of a causal mask in the attention mechanism.
items.capZh: 图 30：注意力机制中因果掩码的示例。

items.en: So, the next question is: how can the model use the causal mask as a position signal? Here's a toy example adapted from the paper.
items.zh: 那么，下一个问题是：模型如何能将因果掩码用作位置信号？这里有一个改编自该论文的玩具示例。

items.en: Suppose one feature of the value vectors is 1 for *The* and 0 for the other three tokens. Since the input contains only one *The*, every visible prefix contains exactly one 1. If all non-masked keys get the same attention score, the softmax assigns every visible token equal weight.
items.zh: 假设值向量的某一个特征在 *The* 处为 1，在其他三个词元处为 0。由于输入中只包含一个 *The*，每个可见前缀都恰好包含一个 1。如果所有未被掩码的键都获得相同的注意力分数，那么 softmax 会给每个可见词元分配相同的权重。

items.en: So at *fox*, attention averages 1, 0, and 0, which gives 1/3. At *jumps*, it averages four values and gets 1/4. In other words, this output feature equals one over the prefix length, which a later layer can use as a signal for position.
items.zh: 因此在 *fox* 处，注意力对 1、0 和 0 求平均，得到 1/3。在 *jumps* 处，它对四个值求平均，得到 1/4。换言之，该输出特征等于前缀长度的倒数，后续层可以将其用作位置信号。

items.capEn: Figure 31: With uniform attention, the contribution from _The_ shrinks as the prefix grows. _The_ query for _fox_ assigns _The_ a weight of 1/3.
items.capZh: 图 31：在均匀注意力下，_The_ 的贡献随前缀增长而缩小。_fox_ 的查询为 _The_ 分配 1/3 的权重。

items.en: Does NoPE work in practice? The researchers of the NoPE paper trained a tiny 107M-parameter decoder-only transformer from scratch on tasks such as copying, sorting, and addition to perform some ablation.
items.zh: NoPE 在实践中有效吗？NoPE 论文的研究者从头训练了一个仅 107M 参数的 decoder-only Transformer，在复制、排序和加法等任务上进行了一些消融实验。

items.en: When they tested the small model on examples longer than those seen during training, interestingly, NoPE ranked first overall across the ten tasks and ahead of RoPE. The researchers behind the NoPE paper also conducted a separate experiment with a larger 1.3B-parameter model trained on code. Here, NoPE also handled contexts beyond the training length; however, its next-token predictions got worse at the longest lengths tested.
items.zh: 当他们用比训练时所见更长的样本测试这个小模型时，有趣的是，NoPE 在十项任务中总体排名第一，并领先于 RoPE。NoPE 论文背后的研究者还进行了一项单独实验，使用一个更大的 1.3B 参数模型在代码上训练。在这里，NoPE 同样能够处理超出训练长度的上下文；然而，在测试的最长长度上，其下一个词预测变得更差。

items.en: (Check the optional Appendix C.3 for an empirical side-by-side comparison between NoPE, RoPE, and the other methods across different tasks.)
items.zh: （请查看可选的附录 C.3，了解 NoPE、RoPE 及其他方法在不同任务上的实证并列比较。）

items.en: Some of today's open-weight LLMs even go so far as to use NoPE in all layers. However, nowadays, it's more common for models to omit RoPE in at least some layers, where layer here means transformer block.
items.zh: 如今一些开放权重 LLM 甚至进一步在所有层中都使用 NoPE。然而，如今更常见的做法是模型在至少某些层中省略 RoPE，这里的层指的是 Transformer 块。

items.en: To give a concrete example, SmolLM3 (3B parameters) applies RoPE in three layers and skips it in the fourth, repeating that pattern through 36 layers. Interestingly, the SmolLM3 authors mentioned that this layer pattern improved long-context performance.
items.zh: 举一个具体例子，SmolLM3（3B 参数）在三个层中应用 RoPE，在第四层中跳过它，并在 36 层中重复该模式。有趣的是，SmolLM3 的作者提到，这种层模式改善了长上下文性能。

items.en: (Also note that any later layer, following the first one, even though it may skip the rotation, still receives the inputs from preceding transformer blocks, so its queries and keys still receive some sort of position information from earlier layers.)
items.zh: （另请注意，在第一个层之后的任何后续层，即使它可能跳过旋转，仍然会接收来自前面 Transformer 块的输入，因此其查询和键仍然会从更早的层获得某种位置信息。）

items.capEn: Figure 32: SmolLM3’s architecture (left) and the positional method used in each of its 36 transformer blocks (right). Every fourth block skips RoPE. Architecture diagram from my LLM Architecture Gallery.
items.capZh: 图 32：SmolLM3 的架构（左）及其 36 个 Transformer 块中各自使用的位置方法（右）。每第四个块跳过 RoPE。架构图来自我的 LLM 架构画廊。

full.secZh: 6.3 学习到的相对位置偏置

items.en: Before we get to the overview and look at what modern architectures use, there's one more method to introduce. For instance, Thinky's Inkling uses a learned relative position bias in both its sliding-window and global attention layers. It computes the usual scaled dot product between a query and key, and then it adds a certain number to that score before the softmax in the attention score computation. That number depends on the query token's hidden state and how many positions back the key is.
items.zh: 在进入概述、了解现代架构采用何种做法之前，还有最后一种方法需要介绍。例如，Thinky 的 Inkling 在其滑动窗口注意力层和全局注意力层中都使用了学习到的相对位置偏置。它先计算 query 与 key 之间常规的缩放点积，然后在注意力分数计算中的 softmax 之前，给该分数加上一个特定的数值。这个数值取决于 query token 的隐藏状态，以及 key 往回相隔多少个位置。

items.en: Let's reuse our example sentence, "The red fox jumps over the gray fox." (It's the last time, I promise!) In the figure below, the "the" at position 5 is the query and "fox" at position 2 is the key. Inkling then uses the three-position gap between query and key and the hidden state for "the" to compute the bias, then adds it to the scaled dot product.
items.zh: 我们再次使用示例句子“The red fox jumps over the gray fox.”（这是最后一次，我保证！）在下图中，位置 5 的“the”是 query，位置 2 的“fox”是 key。Inkling 随后利用 query 与 key 之间相隔三个位置这一信息，以及“the”的隐藏状态来计算偏置，再将其加到缩放点积上。

items.capEn: Figure 33: Inkling adds a learned relative position bias to the scaled query-key dot product before softmax. The numbers are illustrative.
items.capZh: 图 33：Inkling 在 softmax 之前向缩放后的查询-键点积添加学习到的相对位置偏置。数字仅为示意。

items.en: This is not an entirely new idea. Some of you may recall Google's popular T5 (Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer) in 2019, which used a simpler version of this idea.
items.zh: 这并非一个全新的想法。有些人可能还记得 Google 在 2019 年推出的广受欢迎的 T5（Text-to-Text Transfer Transformer），它使用了这一想法的更简单版本。

items.capEn: Figure 34: The original Inkling (975B) architecture. The learned relative position bias feeds into the attention module. LLM Architecture Gallery
items.capZh: 图 34：原始 Inkling（975B）架构。学习到的相对位置偏置输入到注意力模块。LLM 架构画廊

items.en: (Note the ALiBi method, an alternative to RoPE, also adds bias before the softmax, as explained in the optional Appendix C.2.)
items.zh: （注意，作为 RoPE 替代方案的 ALiBi 方法同样在 softmax 之前加入偏置，详见可选的附录 C.2。）

full.sec: 6.4 How these choices appear in recent models
full.secZh: 6.4 这些选择在近期模型中的体现

items.en: Now, after all this build up, the interesting question is: which architecture uses which method? And what are the recent trends?
items.zh: 现在，经过所有这些铺垫，有趣的问题是：哪种架构使用了哪种方法？以及近期的趋势是什么？

items.en: To answer this, I grouped the entries in my LLM Architecture Gallery by their listed release dates and compared the 2025 releases with the earlier and later releases in the 2026 snapshot. Each gallery card counts once, so multiple variants of an architecture can contribute to the results. LLM Architecture Gallery
items.zh: 为了回答这个问题，我按照发布日期对 LLM 架构库中的条目进行了分组，并将 2025 年的发布与 2026 年快照中较早和较晚的发布进行了比较。每个库卡片计数一次，因此一个架构的多个变体可以贡献到结果中。LLM 架构库

items.capEn: Figure 35: The architecture diagrams illustrate which attention layers use RoPE, and the bars show the share of gallery entries in each category. Diagrams from my LLM Architecture Gallery.
items.capZh: 图 35：架构图展示了哪些注意力层使用 RoPE，条形图显示了画廊条目在各类别中的占比。图来自我的 LLM 架构画廊。

items.en: As we can see in Figure 35 above, using RoPE in _every_ softmax attention layer is still the most common choice. However, its use fell from 2025 to 2026, and then also in the latter half of 2026, which could be a trend.
items.zh: 如上图 35 所示，在**每个** softmax 注意力层中使用 RoPE 仍然是最常见的选择。然而，其使用率从 2025 年到 2026 年有所下降，然后在 2026 年下半年也下降了，这可能是一个趋势。

items.en: Consequently, there is a growing number of models that mix RoPE and NoPE. The groups are still small, so it’s hard to say whether these trends will continue.
items.zh: 因此，混合使用 RoPE 和 NoPE 的模型数量在增加。这些组仍然很小，所以很难说这些趋势是否会持续。

items.en: The _NoPE only_ entries were all recurrent hybrids with softmax attention layers that use no explicit positional encoding. The “Other” category here refers to xLSTM 7B (2025) and Inkling (2026). xLSTM has no softmax attention layers. Inkling adds a learned bias to the attention scores before softmax, as we saw in Section 6.3.
items.zh: **仅 NoPE** 的条目都是带有 softmax 注意力层的循环混合模型，这些层不使用显式位置编码。这里的“其他”类别指的是 xLSTM 7B（2025）和 Inkling（2026）。xLSTM 没有 softmax 注意力层。Inkling 在 softmax 之前向注意力分数添加了一个学习到的偏置，正如我们在第 6.3 节中看到的那样。

items.en: Among the models that use RoPE, partial RoPE became more common from 2025 to 2026. It went from a minority of the RoPE models in 2025 to a majority in both 2026 groups, as shown in Figure 36.
items.zh: 在使用 RoPE 的模型中，部分 RoPE（partial RoPE）从 2025 年到 2026 年变得更加普遍。如图 36 所示，它从 2025 年 RoPE 模型中的少数派，变为 2026 年两个组别中的多数派。

items.capEn: Figure 36: Among gallery entries that use RoPE, partial RoPE rotates a subset of query and key features in at least one attention layer. Full-width entries rotate all query and key features in every layer that uses RoPE.
items.capZh: 图 36：在使用 RoPE 的画廊条目中，部分 RoPE 在至少一个注意力层中旋转查询和键特征的子集。全宽条目在每一层使用 RoPE 的层中旋转所有查询和键特征。

items.zh: 如果你想查阅 2026 年组别中的某个具体模型，下面的图 37 展示了 2026 年模型总览，其中各个架构按位置类型进行了标注。你也可以在此处交互式浏览该总览。

items.capEn: Figure 37: The individual 2026 gallery entries behind the two 2026 bars in Figure 35.
items.capZh: 图 37：图 35 中两个 2026 条形图背后的各个 2026 画廊条目。

full.secZh: 7. 结语

items.en: So, to recap, we discussed GPT-2 and the original Transformer that add a position vector to each token embedding before the first Transformer block. Then, modern LLMs switched to RoPE, which encodes relative position inside attention by rotating queries and keys. Surprisingly, RoPE remains the most popular positional embedding method today.
items.zh: 那么，回顾一下：我们讨论了 GPT-2 以及最初的 Transformer，它们在第一个 Transformer 块之前为每个词元嵌入加上一个位置向量。随后，现代 LLM 转向了 RoPE，它通过旋转查询和键，在注意力机制内部编码相对位置。令人惊讶的是，RoPE 至今仍是最流行的位置嵌入方法。

items.en: Recently, however, Inkling picked up an idea from T5 to add a learned relative position bias to the attention scores before softmax. And then we also have NoPE-RoPE architectures, which omit RoPE in some layers.
items.zh: 然而最近，Inkling 借鉴了 T5 的一个想法，在 softmax 之前向注意力分数加入一个可学习的相对位置偏置。此外还有 NoPE-RoPE 架构，它在某些层中省略了 RoPE。

items.en: It may be boring news, but as mentioned before, RoPE is still the predominant position embedding method, and I think this will carry over into 2027 for sure. Perhaps, though, we'll see more architectures with an Inkling-like design coming up in 2027.
items.zh: 这或许听起来是个无聊的消息，但正如前面提到的，RoPE 仍然是占主导地位的位置嵌入方法，我认为这一局面肯定会延续到 2027 年。不过，也许在 2027 年我们会看到更多采用类似 Inkling 设计的架构出现。

items.en: While this may sound "boring", I am glad that I finally got this article on RoPE (and other position info methods) out, after so many years, so that I can add it to my collection of LLM "fundamentals" explainers.
items.zh: 尽管这听起来可能“无聊”，但我很高兴，经过这么多年，我终于把这篇关于 RoPE（以及其他位置信息方法）的文章写出来了，这样我就可以把它加入我的 LLM“基础知识”讲解系列合集。

items.en: If you are interested in the other architecture building blocks of LLMs, I still highly recommend starting with a GPT-2-style model, which will give you a solid understanding of the building blocks with the least amount of friction. And from there, you can then layer on additional methods (such as RoPE).
items.zh: 如果你对 LLM 的其他架构构建模块感兴趣，我仍然强烈建议从 GPT-2 风格的模型开始，这将让你以最小的阻力扎实地理解这些构建模块。然后，你可以在此基础上叠加其他方法（如 RoPE）。
